title: A lululemon board director on the NACD keynote — 'The book gives the reader a lot to contemplate and is well worth the read'
summary: Henry is a board director at lululemon and a best-selling author. She wrote up four days at the NACD Directors Summit and recorded that Eric opened by saying his Instagram post about addressing corporate directors drew a flood of messages telling him to tell them.
blockquote: The book gives the reader a lot to contemplate and is well worth the read. It makes the case that mission-driven companies can create lasting value, and that governance can either protect that mission or erode it, depending on how thoughtfully it's designed.
